detaileddescription.para: override to make unary plus/minus expressions have the same precedence as binary plus; everything else remains the same.

For unparsing the dimension attribute of an entity in a type declaration.
oneVarOnly
- true means there is only one declared variable in the type declaration. If oneVarOnly is false , unparses dimension attribute of the given array type and other attributes of its base type.

For unparsing the length attribute of an entity in a type declaration.
oneVarOnly
- true means there is only one declared variable in the type declaration. If oneVarOnly is false , unparses length attribute of the given string type

For unparsing the attributes of an entity in a type declaration.
oneVarOnly
- true means there is only one declared variable in the type declaration. If oneVarOnly is false , unparses relevant attributes of the given type.

For unparsing language keywords (allows option for upper or lower case)
keyword
- the keyword to unparse
info
- object containing unparsing options
